title: upgrading-dbt-core issue corpus entry
description: One migration issue derived from the Migration Analysis DB. One YAML file per issue.

issue_id.description: Stable identity: 1_<X>_<NNN> (3-digit), where X is the minor version whose upgrade boundary introduced the change. There is no to-version: every project is migrated all the way to the newest core, not one minor bump. Never changes on reorder. NOTE: always quote this in YAML — bare 1_3_001 parses as the integer 13001 under YAML 1.1 digit-separator rules.

from_version.description: The version a project is ON when it hits this issue; drives collection filtering (a project on X collects every issue with from_version >= X).

to_version.description: The version the change actually landed in. Informational only — it is NOT a migration target; every project is migrated to the newest core regardless.

automation_type.description: How the issue is resolved. deterministic -> dbt-autofix handles it (the skill only maps its diff + verifies). agentic -> the skill applies the fix directly, then verifies. human -> the skill proposes a fix, confirms with the user, then applies (HITL). behavior_flag -> a post-1.8 backwards-incompatible change that dbt ships gated behind a behavior-change flag; we do NOT fix the underlying behavior, we just set the gating flag explicitly to its legacy value in dbt_project.yml so behavior stays consistent and the project parses on the newest core.

behavior_flag.description: Required when automation_type is behavior_flag: which dbt_project.yml `flags:` entry gates this change, and the value that preserves legacy (pre-change) behavior.

name.description: Flag key as it appears under `flags:` in dbt_project.yml.

set_to.description: Value that preserves the legacy behavior (normally false).

out_of_repo_risk.description: true -> the fix may reach things outside the repo (job --select, selectors.yml, BI tools, mesh refs); surfaced in the results report for the user regardless of automation_type.

environment_change.description: true -> dependency / Python-runtime / profiles change. Advisory edit only, never executed, and excluded from the parse-verify loop.
